title: MCP++ ExecutionResult@1
description: Portable execution outcome for a single attempt against an ExecutionEnvelope@1. Carries status, output CIDs, state transitions, side effects, decision/delegation refs, executor identity, retry metadata, duration, portable errors, proofs, and optional signature/event_cid. Interface: ExecutionResult@1. Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/execution-envelope.md.
$comment: Interface label: ExecutionResult@1. Schema marker: mcp++/execution/result@1. Results are attempt-scoped; ExecutionReceipt@1 is the content-addressed attestation that binds a result into the Event DAG.

envelope_cid.description: CID of the ExecutionEnvelope@1 this result answers.

intent_cid.description: Intent CID echoed from the envelope when present.

status.description: Terminal attempt status for this result.

output_cids.description: Content-addressed outputs produced by the attempt. Empty when status is not succeeded and no partial outputs are published.

primary_output_cid.description: Optional primary output among output_cids. When set, MUST appear in output_cids.

state_transitions.description: Observed shared-state transitions under declared StateRef modes. Empty when no state was written.

side_effects.description: Observed side effects (I/O, tool mutations, external writes). Empty when none were observed or declared.

decision_cid.description: CID of the policy decision (Profile D / DecisionObject). Null when no deontic evaluation applied.

delegation_cid.description: CID of the effective UCAN / delegation proof used for authority. Null when authority was local-only (same trust domain).

proof_cid.description: Optional single proof-bundle CID (alias of the primary entry in proofs).

executor.description: Identity of the executor that produced this result. Transport PeerID alone is never sufficient authority.

retry.description: Retry / attempt metadata for durable executors and clients.

duration_ms.description: Measured execution duration in milliseconds (may be fractional).

error.description: PortableError@1 when status is not succeeded; MUST be null on success.

proofs.description: Proof CIDs checked or emitted (UCAN chains, evaluation witnesses, attestations).

signature.description: Optional executor signature over the canonical result bytes. Cross-trust-domain results SHOULD be signed; local same-trust results MAY omit.

signature_alg.description: Signature algorithm. Default suite is Ed25519 (ADR-0002). Required when signature is non-null for new mints.

event_cid.description: Optional Event DAG node CID that links this result into provenance history. Receipts SHOULD set this when published to Profile F.

started_at_ms.description: Attempt start wall-clock time (epoch ms). Informational; not causal authority.

finished_at_ms.description: Attempt finish wall-clock time (epoch ms). MUST be >= started_at_ms.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation hook carried from the envelope.

resource_use_cid.description: Optional CID of a resource-use / cost record (aligns with Profile G resource_use_cid).

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization algorithm used when this result is content-addressed. Required on new mints that publish a result CID.

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

signature.description: Signature bytes encoded as lowercase hex or base64url. Cryptographic verification is a higher conformance level than structural schema acceptance.

executionStatus.description: Terminal attempt status. Aligns with Profile G TaskReceipt statuses plus rejected/timed_out.

key_id.description: Explicit key id used for signatures (ADR-0002).

peer_id.description: Optional transport PeerID. NEVER grants UCAN capabilities by itself (KD-14).

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number for this envelope under the durable executor / client retry policy.

previous_result_cid.description: CID of the previous attempt result when this is a retry.

reason.description: Short reason for the retry (e.g. retryable network fault).

state_ref_cid.description: CID of the StateRef@1 (or historical state handle) that was read or written.

mode.description: Consistency mode when known. MUST match the StateRef mode (KD-8).

from_version.description: Prior version / clock / CAS token as opaque string.

to_version.description: Resulting version / clock / CAS token as opaque string.

transition_cid.description: Optional CID of a transition record or CRDT op.

kind.description: Side-effect class (e.g. tool.write, network.http, fs.mutate, capability:write).

effect_cid.description: CID of a structured effect record when published.

description.description: Short human-readable effect summary. MUST NOT embed secrets.

compensatable.description: Whether durable executors may schedule compensation for this effect.
